class DonchianTurtle1m(NoraStrategy):
    """Kênh Donchian Breakout 15 nến 1m, chốt lời nhanh khi chạm biên trên."""
    timeframe = "1m"

    upper_period = 15
    lower_period = 10
    stop_loss_pct = 1.0
    take_profit_pct = 0.7
    trailing_stop_pct = 0.0
    trailing_activation_pct = 0.0
    timeout = 40
    risk_per_trade_pct = 1.0

    def on_bar(self):
        upper = self.feat.donchian_upper(high, self.upper_period)
        lower = self.feat.donchian_lower(low, self.lower_period)
        breakout_entry = close >= upper * 0.999
        trailing_exit = close < lower
        self.close(trailing_exit)
        self.buy(breakout_entry)
note: Chiến lược 1m siêu tốc cho BTC/ETH - Bot #4
